deliberation: Pass metadata: reviewer_system_id=openai-gpt-5.6-sol; logical_pass_id=GI-COUNCIL-INDEPENDENT-CONTRIBUTOR-INTAKE-001/composer/read-only-v1; mode=non_authoring_read_only; exact_subject=matter_sha256:6f1280f8c7bdfd9195f266077666fe54270efe0b1a721a33c92614a99b9c2130. The lifecycle is coherent if dispatch, blind cohort, raw intake, receipt, synthesis, adjudication, and incorporation are explicit stages. Concurrency introduces two additional needs: a cohort closure rule and a late/corrected-return rule. Without them, synthesis timing becomes race-dependent and a slow contributor can either contaminate or be silently discarded.
discharged_obligations: Integrated dispatch, transport, concurrency, receipt, correction, synthesis, adjudication, and incorporation into one lifecycle.
Checked failure recovery and late-return behavior under concurrent execution.
findings: Blind independence requires cohort-level state rather than only per-contribution metadata.
Late returns should remain preserved evidence even when excluded from a closed cohort's comparative synthesis.
Corrections must not replace the earlier raw artifact.
conditions: Each blind cohort must declare membership or a closure condition before dispatch; closure must be durably recorded before cross-contribution synthesis begins.
Late returns after cohort closure are preserved with late_for_cohort status and may seed a successor cohort or separate adjudication, but must not silently alter the completed blind comparison.
Synthesis artifacts must list every contribution digest consumed and every dispatched-but-missing member at closure.
residual_uncertainty: For open-ended human collaborations, fixed cohort membership may be impractical; the pilot should test only bounded cohorts.
